result.quote: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
result.reason: The key is uniquely supported: the two divisions going off duty are assigned to guard the LORD’s house. “Yahweh” co-refers to “the LORD.” However, “groups not serving on Sabbath” is awkward and potentially misleading because they still have a guarding duty. A clearer wording would be: “What are the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath to do?”
